description: Round-11 final mainline that tests data-distribution repair instead of further architectural edits by oversampling missing-rivet train images on the public and targeted-clean branches.

metadata_defaults.notes: Round 11 treats class-distribution imbalance as the likely bottleneck and keeps the N2 recipe fixed while oversampling missing-rivet train images.

experiments.name: O1_yolo11n_i800_public_mrdup_x2
experiments.title: Public branch with missing-rivet train-image oversampling x2

metadata.notes: Duplicates train images containing missing-rivet once so the class appears in more batches without changing val/test.

experiments.name: O2_yolo11n_i800_public_mrdup_x3
experiments.title: Public branch with missing-rivet train-image oversampling x3

metadata.notes: Stronger public-branch oversampling to test whether missing-rivet needs more aggressive train-time exposure.

experiments.name: O3_yolo11n_i800_targetedclean_mrdup_x2
experiments.title: Targeted-clean branch with missing-rivet train-image oversampling x2

metadata.notes: Combines the best available train-only cleanup branch with moderate missing-rivet oversampling to test whether cleaner labels unlock the class-balance gain.
